findings.title: Health Care's 46% multiple compression signals margin bets
findings.body: Health Care's forward P/E sits at the 91st percentile while trailing is at the 81st, a 10-point gap. The 46% compression between trailing and forward earnings implies analysts expect a sharp profit rebound.

findings.title: Materials' 50-point percentile gap is extreme
findings.body: Materials' trailing P/E is at the 93rd percentile but forward drops to the 44th, a 50-point gap. This implies the market prices in a dramatic earnings surge, with implied growth of 122%.

findings.title: Utilities' forward percentile plunges despite modest P/E
findings.body: Utilities' forward P/E percentile fell 32 points in a month to the 25th, while trailing sits at the 10th. The 15-point gap between lenses suggests expectations of steady, but not explosive, earnings growth.
